values.task_boundary: Issue #528 PROV-C only; implement the Vertex AI Gemini provider transport and shared Gemini codec reuse without live GCP mutation, credential exposure, #509 qualification, or unrelated provider rewrites.
deliverables: Vertex AI Gemini provider transport source changes
Shared Gemini semantic codec source changes or extraction
Operator documentation for Vertex AI IAM/API/ADC/location/quota/non-claims
Optional live Vertex AI smoke-test packet requiring separate authorization
Typed C-SDLC v2 lifecycle cards, review, publication, and terminal truth
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: ADL exposes Vertex AI as a distinct provider transport without duplicating the Gemini semantic codec
AC-2: Vertex AI authentication uses ADC or workload identity and does not require or persist a Gemini API key
AC-3: Requests resolve explicit project, location, endpoint, publisher/model identity, timeout, and cancellation boundaries
AC-4: Streaming and non-streaming Gemini responses normalize into the existing ADL provider result contract
AC-5: UTS tool declarations and returned tool calls preserve both tool names and arguments; tests reject incorrect argument mappings
AC-6: IAM, authentication, quota, billing, safety, retryable/non-retryable errors, and redaction map into common provider failure and observability contracts
AC-7: Provider receipts distinguish gemini_developer_api from vertex_ai and contain no access tokens, credentials, prompt bodies, or raw sensitive responses
AC-8: Existing Gemini Developer API, OpenRouter, Bedrock, and Ollama focused provider tests remain green
AC-9: Any live Vertex call is separately authorized, cost-bounded, region-recorded, and reported as provider qualification rather than local deterministic proof
dependencies: #514 shared provider inference profiles is terminal/completed
#509 GCP portability qualification is separate and not a prerequisite for deterministic #528 implementation
Live Vertex AI smoke testing requires aiplatform.googleapis.com, suitable IAM, ADC/workload identity, quota, region/model availability, and explicit operator authorization
non_goals: Rewriting the existing Gemini adapter from scratch
Replacing Ollama, MLX, Bedrock, OpenRouter, or direct Gemini access
GCP foundation, Terraform, networking, production deployment, or #509 qualification
Enabling APIs or mutating GCP IAM
Executing live provider calls without separate authorization
Claiming all Gemini Developer API features are identical on Vertex AI without evidence
